categories.main_business_segments: WUS Printed Circuit (Kunshan) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing industry, focusing on single, double-sided, multilayer, and high-density interconnect (HDI) PCBs. The company serves key segments including enterprise communications market boards, automotive boards, office and industrial equipment boards, semiconductor chip testing boards, and consumer electronics boards. It also engages in related product sales, after-sales services, and supply chain management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including high-density interconnect (HDI) technology, multilayer PCB production, embedded power semiconductor technology (p2Pack), laser drilling, backdrill stub technology, and mixed material lamination. It emphasizes continuous process innovation, automation, and intelligent manufacturing to improve product quality and production efficiency. The firm also invests in developing domestic substitutes for key materials and advanced signal integrity technologies for high-speed PCBs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: WUS serves major customers in the enterprise communications sector, automotive electronics, data centers, semiconductor testing, and industrial equipment markets. Its products are critical components for AI servers, high-speed networking equipment, automotive electronic systems including electric and hybrid vehicles, and consumer electronics. The company maintains long-term strategic partnerships with leading domestic and international clients, often collaborating on product development and design.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Kunshan, Huangshi, and other locations, and has expanded overseas with a production facility under construction in Thailand and a trading subsidiary in Singapore. Its sales are predominantly export-oriented, serving markets in Asia-Pacific, the Americas, Europe, and other global regions. The company is actively diversifying its geographic footprint to mitigate geopolitical and trade risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: WUS operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer of printed circuit boards, which are essential intermediate components for electronic devices. It sources raw materials such as copper-clad laminates and copper foil, processes them into PCBs, and supplies these to downstream electronics manufacturers and OEMs in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in high-end PCB technologies to support AI computing, high-speed networking, and automotive electronics. Key R&D initiatives include developing high-density HDI boards, advanced materials for high-speed signal integrity, embedded power semiconductor packaging, and automotive-grade PCBs with enhanced reliability. It also focuses on automation, intelligent manufacturing, and green production to improve efficiency and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: WUS generates revenue primarily through the sale of printed circuit boards and related products. Additional income streams include property sales, property management services, and sales of scrap materials. The company also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial assets. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance, with some income recognized over service periods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: WUS is positioned as a leading PCB manufacturer in China and globally, recognized as a top 100 PCB enterprise by industry associations. It competes with other major PCB producers in China, Taiwan, Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia. The company differentiates itself through technological innovation, product quality, and strategic focus on high-end market segments such as AI servers and automotive electronics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, WUS achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 8.94 billion, representing a 7.23% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 1.51 billion, up 11.09% from the previous year. The company’s total assets grew by 28.27% to RMB 16.04 billion, reflecting expansion and acquisitions. It maintains a strong cash flow position and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: WUS emphasizes its technological leadership, high product quality, and ability to rapidly meet diverse customer demands as its core value proposition. The company focuses on differentiated, high-value PCB products tailored for emerging markets like AI computing and automotive electronics. Its integrated production and supply chain management, combined with strong customer relationships and continuous innovation, provide competitive advantages in cost control, delivery reliability, and product performance.
